end.summary:
Riya discussed Pongal, Lohri, Makar Sankranti and Bihu.
They identified festival foods such as pongal and rewri.
They described harvest as a shared thread among festivals.
Teach-back was not completed; the lesson ended when Riya felt tired.
end.parentNote: Asha practised finding common links and differences across festivals, using foods and harvest as examples. Riya recalled several festival names and connected them with harvest traditions. They mixed up the timing by saying the festivals all come in January or winter; this was not corrected before the lesson ended. At home, compare two festivals using a simple table with columns for season, food and shared tradition.
